heading: Books that change a decision this week
intro: Not a shoebox service and not a fractional CFO — the specific middle: current books, reconciled to the kitchen, explained in plain language.

items.title: Weekly close, not a year-end surprise
items.description: Books close every Friday. You see food cost and labor cost drift while there's still a week left to fix it, not three months later on a tax return.

items.title: POS-to-ledger reconciliation
items.description: Toast, Square, and Clover feeds are reconciled line by line against vendor invoices and payroll, so the P&L reflects what actually left the kitchen and the register.

items.title: Margin coaching, not just categorizing
items.description: A monthly 30-minute call walks through the three levers that move restaurant margin — plate cost, labor mix, and waste — with your real numbers, not a generic benchmark.
